title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program 2026-27 Booked-Day Fee Schedule: Plan Supplement
content:
Under the board-approved 2026-27 booked-day fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, a plan supplement is added to a booked day. It follows the number of program days per week covered by the enrollment's plan.

| Program days per week of the plan | Plan supplement |
|---|---|
| two | 5.00 |
| three or four | 3.00 |
| five | nothing |

| Plan | Days per week | Plan supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) | 2 | 5.00 |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | 3 | 3.00 |
| Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | nothing |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | nothing |
| Creek Kids Club Before & After-School Care (5 Days) | 5 | nothing |
| Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | 5 | nothing |

The plan read is the plan the enrollment holds when the day is priced. No current plan runs four days per week; such a plan would carry 3.00.
